mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic weakness, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 (p > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative returns in at least 60% of cases (p > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: A supply-driven slowdown (INDPRO < 110) reduces industrial output and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 110 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 3.0% annually signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which depresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 (p > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0) and elevated interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0) signals a dual economic threat, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to weak labor market and tight monetary policy.
failure_condition: The joint condition UNRATE > 5.0 AND FEDFUNDS > 5.0 does not produce negative returns in at least 60% of cases (p > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: A housing market downturn (HOUST < 1800 thousand units) reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1800 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
